- **Vantorre Mobility:** Gideon Sato. The 5/4 digest says he took it over that day. Earlier digests already call it "Gideon's fleet account", so I can't tell whether he held it before 5/4.
- **Orlavine Medical Supply:** Gideon Sato, most likely. The Sep 2025 and Sep 30, 2026 digests refer to "Gideon's medical account". The latest digest names Orlavine as 55 seats, but it never ties the name to Gideon directly. A March 2025 digest called it "Nadia's medical account", so it has changed hands at some point.
- **Quillfeather Outfitters:** I can't confirm an owner. The digests only say "the Strategic pod's outdoor/retail account". Nadia is the only person shown working on it, in the 9/30 training session. That isn't an ownership statement. Please check the CRM before it goes on the slide.
